decks.notes: The main concept of this combo deck is to utilize various spells and creature abilities to quickly mill through the deck and fill the graveyard with key cards like Bridge from Below and Thassa's Oracle. By combining cards like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Simian Spirit Guide for mana acceleration, players can bring out powerful combo pieces like Undercity Informer and Balustrade Spy to mill through the deck, reanimate creatures like Narcomoeba, and ultimately win the game with Thassa's Oracle for a game-winning finish.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting opponents with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. Its mana acceleration from cards like Grim Monolith and Ancient Tomb allows for explosive plays while also utilizing land destruction with Wasteland and Ghost Quarter. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their game plan using a combination of lock pieces and powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using cards like Entomb and Reanimate to bring them back into play for a quick and strong board presence. With cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with hard-to-deal with threats early in the game. The combination of graveyard manipulation, creature recursion, and disruption spells make this deck a consistent and powerful force in the Legacy format.

The main focus of the deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate high-impact creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control elements, ultimately leading to a swift victory through reanimated creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with efficient beatdown creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by a suite of disruption spells such as Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board using tempo plays like Wasteland, while also leveraging card filtering and selection tools such as Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Questing Druid provides additional threats and versatility in dealing with various types of opponents. Overall, the deck aims to maintain aggressive, proactive gameplay while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Doomsday combo deck is to use Doomsday to set up a winning situation by stacking the deck with cards like Thassa's Oracle and The One Ring, while using cards like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to control the game and protect the combo. Through careful planning and strategic use of resources like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond effectively.

The main idea of this deck is to combine the cards Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire deck in one turn. This combo is supported by cards like Voltaic Key, Basalt Monolith, and Urza's Workshop to generate mana quickly. The deck also includes other artifacts like Mox Opal and Grim Monolith to further accelerate the combo. Karn, the Great Creator is used as a versatile toolbox to find specific artifacts when needed. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can react.

This deck focuses on quickly generating mana and assembling the necessary combo pieces to cast a large number of spells in a single turn to win the game. Key cards include Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond, and Echo of Eons to generate mana and draw cards, as well as Tendrils of Agony as the win condition. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo. The goal is to combo off and storm off with spells to deal lethal damage to the opponent in one turn.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using Cloudposts and other lands in order to cast big Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes cards like Crop Rotation to search for specific lands, Once Upon a Time to find key pieces, and Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing decks. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and control the game with disruptive tools like Bojuka Bog and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale. The ultimate goal is to set up a winning board state while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the necessary combo pieces to win the game in a single turn. By utilizing fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, along with powerful self-mill cards like Undercity Informer and Balustrade Spy, the deck aims to get Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield and win the game by emptying the library. The deck also includes protection in the form of Pact of Negation and disruption with cards like Cabal Therapy. Overall, the deck is focused on executing a powerful combo as quickly and efficiently as possible.

This deck focuses on assembling the Cephalid Breakfast combo, utilizing cards like Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to enable milling and triggering effects from cards like Narcomoeba and Dread Return. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or combat damage. The deck also includes cards for protection and deck manipulation like Force of Will, Brainstorm, and Ponder. Urza's Saga can help tutor for key combo pieces while also providing additional value. The deck is built around fast and efficient combo play with a focus on graveyard synergy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly generate mana and use it to cast powerful spells such as Necrodominance and Pact of Negation to assemble a game-winning combo. The deck focuses on explosive plays and fast mana acceleration through cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox. By efficiently using rituals and mana-producing creatures, the deck aims to overpower opponents and win the game through either a storm count with Tendrils of Agony or by utilizing the alternative win condition of Beseech the Mirror.

The deck focuses on using cards that disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence quickly. It combines aggressive creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Stoneforge Mystic with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value by blinking key creatures and permanents. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive strategy and to disrupt opponent's lands with cards like Wasteland.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, and disruptive cards like Stifle and Dress Down. The goal is to quickly deploy a powerful threat in Phyrexian Dreadnought and protect it while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and filtering to find the necessary pieces, along with a few additional win conditions like Curie, Emergent Intelligence and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Overall, the deck aims to maintain control of the game and dictate the pace of play.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal, and powerful creatures equipped with equipment. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also being able to put pressure on the board with Stoneforge Mystic and other creatures. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Teferi, Time Raveler provide card advantage and disruption, while Orcish Bowmasters can take out key creatures. The deck is versatile with various ways to answer threats and maintain control of the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plans while maintaining board presence through tempo plays. It utilizes hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to control the game early on. Murktide Regent serves as a powerful threat that can quickly close out games. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opponent's threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes Wasteland to disrupt opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting opponent's game plan.
